name: EXM_CC_COMPANY_ACCOUNTS
description: This table contains the business units that are responsible for payment to the card issuer, payment liability, payment terms, and the card issuer's payment address for a corporate card program.

columns.name: CC_COMPANY_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a company account number.

columns.name: COMPANY_ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.description: User-defined name representing a division, department, or cost center that issues corporate cards to its employees.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TERM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the payment term used for reimbursing the corporate card issuer.

columns.name: CARD_PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the corporate card program associated with the company account number.

columns.name: COMPANY_NUMBER
columns.description: Corporate account numbers assigned by the corporate card issuer to the deploying company or its business unit.

columns.name: CARD_ISSUER_NUMBER
columns.description: Number assigned by the payment processor that identifies a card issuer in the payment processor's system.

columns.name: CARD_ISSUER_ID
columns.description: Name of the bank or entity that issues corporate credit cards.

columns.name: CARD_ISSUER_SITE_ID
columns.description: Geographical address of the corporate card issuer.

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the company account cannot be used.

columns.name: CORPORATE_CARD_ADMIN
columns.description: User who is authorized to maintain a corporate card program.

columns.name: REQUISITION_BU
columns.description: Business unit responsible for handling invoices for the corporate card issuer.

columns.name: PAYMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency in which the corporate card issuer must be paid.

columns.name: PAYMENT_DUE_FROM_CODE
columns.description: Denotes the liability owner of the company account.

columns.name: EXPENSE_CLEARING_CCID
columns.description: Account that holds accounting for corporate card transactions temporarily.

columns.name: OVERLAY_BALANCING_SEG_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the balancing segment substitutes onto the clearing account's balancing segment from the employee's default expense account.

columns.name: INCL_PERSONAL_EXPENSE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether it is mandatory to include personal expenses in the expense report.

columns.name: BILLING_CNTL_ACCT_NUMBER
columns.description: Number that identifies the party responsible for payment within the deploying company.

columns.name: MARKET_CODE
columns.description: Code issued by the card issuer that identifies the market in which the deploying company operates.

columns.name: INTERBANK_CARDASSOC_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number assigned by the processor to bank issuing corporate cards.

columns.name: TAXPAYER_ID
columns.description: The supplier tax identifier issued by federal tax authorities.

columns.name: TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: The supplier tax identifier for a specific tax registration.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: REAL_TIME_AUTH_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Stores the synchronization status of real-time authorization setup data for the company account.

columns.name: REAL_TIME_AUTH_SYNC_DATE
columns.description: Date and time of when the synchronization of real-time authorization setup data was last successful for the company account.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: BOOK_NUMBER
columns.description: Book number used in American Express remittance advice.

columns.name: LOAD_NUMBER
columns.description: Load number or sender identifier used in American Express remittance advice.

columns.name: PAY_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Code stamped on the payment requests to group card issuer payments in a single pay run.

columns.name: CARD_ISSUER_COUNTRY
columns.description: Country of the registered address of a card issuer for a specific company account that is used in remittance advice

columns.name: BILLING_BASIC_CTRL_ACCT_NUM
columns.description: An account number provided by the card issuer in the charge file that represents the organization that is billed by American Express.

columns.name: CARD_DISGUISE_CTRL_ACCT_NUM
columns.description: An account number assigned to a company by American Express that represents the organizational level at which the company is enrolled in the Card Number Disguising program.

columns.name: MULTI_CURRENCY_ENABLED
columns.description: Indicates whether multiple billed currencies are supported by the company account. Possible values are Y or N.

columns.name: REAL_TIME_AUTH_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether real time authorization data creation is enabled for this company account.

columns.name: CARD_ISSUING_BANK_NUMBER
columns.description: Transmit number assigned to the bank that issues cards associated with the company account. The transmit number is used in remittance advice.

columns.name: CARD_PROCESSOR_BANK_NUMBER
columns.description: Bank identification number assigned by the card processor to the bank that issues cards associated with the company account.  The corporate cards are issued under this identification number. Bank identification number is used in remittance advice.
